verdict.line: You lose fast trades into her Ki Burst stun before level 6, but you win the lane if you survive to level 6 and start dragging fights out with Relentless Assault.

brief.thesis: Riven's whole kit is burst and resource-limited: three Broken Wings (Q) charges on a 13s recharge, a single Ki Burst (W) stun on 11-7s, and one Valor (E) dash on 10-6s — once those are spent she has no follow-up and no escape. Jax's Relentless Assault (R) has no cooldown and keeps ramping attack speed the longer a fight runs, so the matchup is a straight question of whether Riven can end you inside her burst window or whether you survive long enough to out-scale her in the extended fight. Counter Strike (E) also directly answers her passive, since Runic Blade only pays off through basic attacks and E dodges all incoming basic attacks outright.

theirWindow.when: Her W (Ki Burst) is off cooldown
theirWindow.what: She can stun you and chain Q strikes and autos into a real trade. Don't stand still in melee range here — make her commit it on a poke, not a full combo.

yourWindow.what: She has no damage-block or dash to bail with. Commit Leap Strike (Q) into Empower (W) on the auto, and hold Counter Strike (E) for when she tries to fight back with autos.

start.why: The measured starter here, 61.5% win rate over 13 games and 72.2% pick rate — the AD and sustain let you match her early auto trades without losing the lane sustain war.

boots.why: 66.7% win rate over 12 games, 75% pick. Riven's passive Runic Blade only pays off through basic attacks, so flat reduction on her autos blunts the exact damage source her kit is built around.

core.why: Part of the measured path (33.3% over 3 games, 50% pick). The AD, attack speed, and haste directly feed Empower (W) procs and ramp Relentless Assault (R) faster once fights extend.
Second item in the same path. Its on-hit healing and burst keep you winning the extended trade even if Riven lands her Ki Burst (W) stun first.
Closes out the core path. Gives you a reset if she lands Blade of the Exile (R) and a Wind Slash poke later, so you can re-engage the fight on your terms.

runes.keystoneWhy: The measured keystone (27.8% pick). Its ramping attack speed stacks directly with Relentless Assault (R), rewarding the exact drag-the-fight-out plan that beats Riven's burst-and-run kit.

summoners.why: Exhaust+Flash is the highest measured win rate (71.4%, 38.9% pick). Pop Exhaust the moment she commits Ki Burst (W) or activates Blade of the Exile (R) — it cuts both her damage and attack speed mid-combo, exactly when her burst window would otherwise kill you.

playing.title: Punish auto-reliant trades with E
playing.detail: Runic Blade only pays off through her basic attacks, and Counter Strike (E) dodges all incoming basic attacks outright. Time E into her stand-and-trade windows to void that damage source entirely.

playing.title: Don't Leap in blind to her W
playing.detail: Ki Burst (W) damages and stuns everyone around her. If it's up, walking in with Leap Strike (Q) hands her a free stun into a full combo — bait it out with an auto first.

playing.title: All-in after her Q charges are spent
playing.detail: Broken Wings (Q) can fire up to three times before its 13s cooldown starts. Once she's thrown all three hits and the knockback, she has no gap-closer or escape left.

playing.title: Respect Valor as a damage block, not just a dash
playing.detail: Riven's E Valor steps forward and blocks incoming damage on a 10-6s cooldown. Bait it with a basic attack before committing Leap Strike (Q) or an Empower (W) swing into it.

playing.title: Win by extending past level 6
playing.detail: Relentless Assault (R) has no cooldown and keeps ramping attack speed the longer you fight, with bonus damage every third strike. Don't try to burst her in one exchange — drag it out.

playing.title: Hold E through the stun, not to dodge it
playing.detail: Counter Strike (E) dodges basic attacks and reduces AoE damage, but it doesn't grant stun immunity. Use it to erase her auto-attack damage around the stun, not as an escape from Ki Burst itself.

playing.title: Track her ultimate's long cooldown
playing.detail: Blade of the Exile (R) sits on 120/90s cooldown at its first two ranks. Early-to-mid skirmishes after level 6 happen while she has no Wind Slash poke or AD spike to threaten from range.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch via OP.GG; the matchup mechanics, timing windows, and tactical reads are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Block Riven’s basic attacks, third Broken Wings (Q), or Ki Burst (W) with Counter Strike [E].
